headline: Recommended Council receive and place on file Public Services Committee priorities list, 3-0.
summary: Councilor Spang reviewed committee priorities identified by councilors, including affordability, rent stabilization, anti-wage theft, schools, utility management, infrastructure, community engagement, and transparency. The committee recommended the Council receive and place the priorities list on file.
decisions: Recommended the Council receive and place on file the Public Services Committee Priorities (Order #040), 3-0.

# Public Services / Committee of the Whole Meeting Minutes
## Monday, March 16, 2026, 6:00 PM
## Conference Room A
## Beverly City Hall, 3rd Floor, 191 Cabot Street

Posted: 2026 APR 30 A 9:34

Spang called the meeting to order at 6:00 PM.
Members present: Spang, Mullady, Sonia
Members absent: None
Recorded by: Sarah Kirker.

| Order Number | Date to Committee | Description | Action Taken |
|---|---|---|---|
| #040 | 01/20/2026 | Councilor Spang - Public Services Committee Priorities. | Recommend the Council to receive and place on file (3-0). |

Spang explained that the purpose of the exercise was to identify the issues constituents most frequently contact Councilors about, as well as the topics generating the most discussion and the councilors are most interested. The Councilors identified key categories and specific projects to focus on, including affordability (housing, rent stabilization, and anti-wage theft), schools, utility management, infrastructure, community engagement, and transparency.

Photograph of exercise results attached for the record.

A motion to adjourn the Public Services Committee was made and seconded. A vote was taken, and motion carried (3-0). The meeting adjourned at 6:24 PM.
